ideal: Every main commit builds, fast and the same bytes every time, into a small, complete release a room can update to soon after merge.

sources.title: DevOps Research and Assessment: software delivery performance metrics

quality: Every main commit builds, two builds of one commit match byte for byte, and the release passes all five checks.
speed: The web and Mac builds each take a minute or less, a tenth of the ten-minute build.
consumption: A small release: a room downloads only the parts it runs.
